nom: Tree Hut Pineapple & Papaya Brightening Face Scrub

avis.texte: I recently tried the Tree Hut Pineapple & Papaya Brightening Face Scrub, and I’m really impressed! The scrub has a lovely tropical scent that makes using it a refreshing experience. The exfoliating beads are gentle but effective, leaving my skin feeling smooth and clean without being too abrasive. After a few uses, I’ve noticed a brighter complexion, and my skin feels softer and more hydrated. It’s great for my sensitive skin, and I appreciate that it’s free of harsh chemicals. For the price, it’s a high-quality scrub that delivers on its promises. Highly recommend for anyone looking for a natural, brightening face wash!

LOVE! Better than other sugar scrubs that I have tried! I bought this when SunBum stopped making their Brightening Face Scrub that I loved and I needed a comparable. This face scrub has more texture, which I think helps to aid in gently exfoliating my face. I have very sensitive skin + rosacea and I did not find this to be irritating at all. Generously portioned and at a fair price point. This will be my new go-to!

Personally I have tried many facial scrubs and the tree hut facial body scrubs are truly the best ones for my face. I like both the physical and chemical exfoliation it does to my skin and when it's in stock and available, I buy it. The only issue that I have is the pricing. Depending on the seller that is given the product, I tend to realize that sometimes these facial scrubs are now going to the point of like $20 or $25 and respectfully this is where I think they're scamming the customer of what is a really amazing product. Personally, I don't think that these products should be no more than about $15 if anything cheapened them to maybe about $10 deal. Maybe they're doing this because they don't have a whole bunch and stock but I feel like this is where if I'm a part of the tree hut manufacturing company, I would realize that this product is actually quite popular with consumers and start actually making more of these products and make sure that the sellers give it off at a cheaper price other than making people pay 20 something dollars in the name of the product. Nevertheless, I personally enjoy the pineapple/papaya, the blueberry, the banana oat, and the watermelon. Hope they make more and inform the sellers to sell it at a reasonable price. Thank you.

I am giving this 3 stars solely because of the fragrance. It smells very nice but too much. It makes me not want to use it unless necessary. The scrubbing power itself is great, face is smooth afterwards. I have a sensitive face but it doesn't make my face burn. The smell is just way too strong compared to the rest of the "flavors"

I LOVE this facial scrub. Firstly, it smells AMAZING. It’s Tree Hut, so you Kane it’s going to be GREAT quality. Not cheap, but DEFINITELY worth it. It will also last me a WHILE. I use it about twice a week and I don’t have any dead skin on my face.
Smells delicious and is a wonderful exfoliation feel you get. Didn’t cause any issues such as breakouts or irritation which was wonderful.
Love this product. Easy on my very sensitive skin. Smells good also.

avis.titre: Heavenly Smell without the Fragrance Headache
avis.texte: I hate fragrances and I love this! I don't get a headache, I don't break out. It smells unbelievable, it leaves our skin feeling even better, and it works to exfoliate well.

Huele delicioso y deja la piel super suavecita y glowy es un exfoliante intenso, pero no lastima la piel, me gusta mucho su textura de gel y el precio es muy justo ya que el producto me sorprendio con la calidad es muy por encima de lo que esperaba.
El olor es agradable, deja la piel suave, la textura es muy similar al corporal, cumple su funcion muy bien
Muy rico aroma y deja la piel limpia y suave lo recomiendo excelente
Me encantó, deja la piel super suave y desde las primeras aplicaciones comencé a ver un cambio en mi piel, el acné comenzó a desaparecer y aparte tiene un aroma delicioso 😋 Exelente producto
El olor es delicioso aunque no demasiado que abruma. Creo que va a durar mucho porque solo se necesita un poquito con las manos mojadas para que haga su efecto.
Love this sugar scrub and feels great on my skin! If sensitive, I do not recommend.
I ordered a replacement because my original package came swarming with ants. I had to return the original to Kohl’s and never received a replacement.

avis.titre: smells sooo good, they need to make a perfume ASAP
avis.texte: pretty good product, moisturizing and I literally want to eat it
